title: VaultUnlockRequest
description: Params of the vault.unlockRequest server-to-client notification. The backend requests an unlock, naming why; the renderer turns this into the unlock dialog.

requestId.description: Server-assigned opaque id that the vault.unlockResolved response echoes back.

reason.description: Why the unlock is needed, for the dialog's context line. A human-readable sentence, never a code.
